systems.country_label: Unified Economic Number project (Decision No. 348 of 2026)
systems.owner: Ministry of Economy and Trade; National Council for the Unified Economic Number
systems.tiers: ministries, agencies and public institutions linking databases

note: Decision 348 of 2026 is a cabinet decision on a single business identifier for one sector (registered economic entities); it is not a law on public bodies sharing data generally, so it is a systems entry only.
